research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Phaidra is researching deterministic industrial process control by using AI agents to determine setpoint values and select optimal control sources, as described in Deterministic industrial process control. The company is also developing methods for industrial process control using unstructured data, leveraging system templates and control models. Additionally, Phaidra is working on customizable artificial intelligence systems for domain experts to optimize key performance indicators in industrial processes. These efforts focus on AI-driven industrial optimization.
